page.overview:
What is Raid on a Czerka facility?

In 40 BBY, Pijali blackguards executed a raid on a Czerka facility on the moon of the Inner Rim planet Pijal.

The raid on a Czerka facility appeared in Master & Apprentice, a 2019 novel written by Claudia Gray.
